note: E13 — the first LONG-INPUT exam. Judge-free by decision (docs/experiments.md E13 'JUDGE CLAUSE RESOLVED'): four deterministic checks carry every case. GATE runs deterministic (samples=1, temp 0). Per-case expectations live in `expected` and are read by properties.py, which looks them up by exact input text — the model never sees them. CONTEXT CEILING FOUND ON THE FIRST RUN (2026-07-28): long-day-heldout-xl (7597 chars / 2603 prompt tokens) errors with an UNPARSEABLE, mid-JSON-truncated answer because prompt+completion hits exactly 4096 total tokens. sandbox/router.py never sets Ollama's num_ctx, so the DEFAULT context applies — this is a limit of OUR CONFIGURATION, not a proven ceiling of gemma4:e4b-it-qat. Do not report it as a model capability finding. Note the errored case short-circuits scoring, so it says NOTHING about the four checks; it is a harness/config signal only. Fixing it means adding num_ctx to router.py, which touches EVERY exam's inference path and so belongs in its own lane, not this one. MEASURED 2026-07-28 (num_ctx sweep, read-only, router.py NOT changed): at num_ctx=8192 the same case returns COMPLETE JSON and fails check_compression ALONE (535 chars vs the 379 limit); num_ctx=16384 gives byte-identical output, so 8192 is sufficient and more buys nothing. Raising the window therefore converts a harness error into a correctly-attributed CAPABILITY failure — it does not rescue the case, and heldout stays 5/7 either way. The length effect holds at every long case (4292 / 5520 / 7597 all fail compression), so COMPRESSION DEGRADATION IS THE FINDING and the context ceiling was incidental to it.
not_verified: READABILITY / prose quality is NOT measured — no judge, by decision (PR #18 removed the LLM judge suite-wide). TONE and register are not measured. Item RANKING is not measured: check_coverage tests presence, never that the recap ordered items by importance. LONG-HORIZON stability is not measured — every case is single-shot, so this exam tests long INPUT only; multi-turn drift is scoped separately as E20, and shipping this exam does NOT close the 'long' gap. CASE TEXT IS SYNTHETIC, hand-authored in the suite's Belgian-SMB register rather than sampled from a public corpus: committing third-party prose to a public repo republishes it, which the 'public data' decision had not accounted for. Realism is therefore UNVERIFIED against real mail; the checks are unaffected. check_grounded only sees NUMBERS — an invented proper noun with no digits is not caught, matching the known limit of the crm error_recovery rung.
